rules.basis: The NLP and NLX lithium battery sheets state 'Nominal Voltage' as 12.8 V; the NLP sheet prints the bare 12.8 under a volts header. The name is printed on the batteries only.
The NLP and NLX sheets state the pack's capacity under 'Amp-Hours', 7 to 120, with the unit in the name and no rate; the packs are lithium, which waives the rate where the chemistry is recorded.
The NLP and NLX sheets state the pack's energy under 'Watt-Hours', 89.6 to 1536 Wh.

On the NLP and NLX battery sheets 'Charging Current' is the most the pack takes, '24A (Max)' or '100 A'; on the charger sheets the same name is the charger's output and is read under the charger's key.
The GEN and GENPRO charger sheets state 'Charging Current' per bank, '5A (12V)' or '10A (12V)'; a multi-bank figure such as '10Ax2(12V)' is refused until it is read as one bank's.
The NLP and NLX sheets print 'Continuous Current', 20 to 200 A, beside 'Starting Current' and 'Charging Current': the current the pack sustains on discharge, as against the seconds-long engine start.
